ImageDescription.value:
A bridleway with tree reflections at Gernon Bushes Nature Reserve woodland, managed by Essex Wildlife Trust, in the civil parish of Theydon Garnon, but adjoining Coopersale at the north-east of Epping and conjoined with further woodland at the north within North Weald Bassett, in Essex, England. The 79 acre Nature Reserve is the remains of the ancient Coopersale Common, and is a woodland that includes ponds, bogs, and ancient pollarding of hornbeams.
Camera: Canon EOS 6D with Canon EF 24-105mm F4L IS USM lens.
Software: large RAW file lens-corrected, optimized and downsized with DxO OpticsPro 10 Elite, Viewpoint 2, and Adobe Photoshop CS2.
